name: primevul_joint_pairwise_selective_calibration_v1
description: CPU-only reproduction inputs and generated reports for held-out selective calibration of the learned PrimeVul joint pairwise checkpoint.

artifacts.note: Held-out real-pair probabilities from the synthetic-supervised 1.5B joint pairwise checkpoint.

limitations: The prediction JSONL is intentionally not committed because outputs is gitignored.
Accepted accuracy is conditional on abstaining from low-margin pairs and is not a full-coverage gain.
The manifest packages predictions rather than the 1.5B checkpoint, so it reproduces calibration and reporting but not model training.
